meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress a memory file such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list into caveman format to save input tokens, keeping a readable backup. Trigger: /caveman-compress.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把记忆文件或待办清单压成极简格式，省下输入字数，同时留一份好读的备份
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 agent 记忆文件越写越长、每次都要多花词元，又不想丢掉原文
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent memory file keeps growing, costs more tokens each run, and you still want the original kept

howto.what: 把 CLAUDE.md、待办清单等自然语言文件压缩成 caveman 格式,减少输入 token。压缩后覆盖原文件,可读备份存到源码目录之外的数据目录。
howto.when: 当你输入 /caveman-compress <文件路径>,或提出要压缩记忆类文件时接管。

say.note: 压缩后覆盖原文件,备份放到数据目录

say.text: 把 ./TODO.md 压缩成 caveman 格式
say.note: 代码块和路径原样保留,只压说明文字

say.text: 压缩 ./prefs.txt,失败就保留原文件
say.note: 出错重试两次,仍失败则不动原文件

howto.what_en: Compresses natural-language files like CLAUDE.md or todos into caveman-speak to cut input tokens. The compressed text overwrites the original; a readable backup goes to an out-of-tree data dir.
howto.when_en: Runs when you type /caveman-compress <filepath> or ask to compress a memory file.

say_en.note: Original overwritten; backup in data dir
Code blocks and paths kept as-is

say_en.text: Compress ./prefs.txt; keep original if it fails
say_en.note: Retries twice, then leaves file untouched
